document.about: Seagate Exos X16 hard drive data sheet (3 pages). The cover sets a 12.7 pt tagline over the 20.2 pt product name, and the back page sets the site name at 10.5 pt above 6 pt legal text.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.
2026-11-24 (#128): a kicker or tagline set in smaller type directly above the title opened an empty, deeper section ahead of it.

checks.issue: The site name over the legal text was a level-3 heading, with the legal paragraph under it.
The 12.7pt tagline above the 20.2pt product name was an empty level-2 section ahead of the title.
